title: Age limit differs
comment_text: REJECT DORMANT ACCOUNTS OLDER THAN 10 YEARS
code_behaviour: The comment states a 10-year limit, the code rejects after 5 years.

title: Tax is applied although comment says it is not
comment_text: NO TAX IS APPLIED DURING POSTING
code_behaviour: The header comment says no tax is applied, but the code calls TAXCALC2 before the update.

title: Rates are not hard-coded
comment_text: INTEREST RATES ARE HARD-CODED IN WORKING-STORAGE
code_behaviour: The comment claims hard-coded rates; the code reads them via RATETBL. The WORKING-STORAGE rate table is unused.

title: Output target differs
code_behaviour: The comment says SYSOUT; the code passes pages to PRTSPOOL (missing module) instead.

title: Handler can abend
comment_text: THIS ROUTINE NEVER ABENDS - IT ONLY LOGS
code_behaviour: The comment says the routine never abends; the code calls CEE3ABD for severity ≥ 12.

title: Date format differs
code_behaviour: The comment documents DD.MM.YYYY, the picture string passed to CEEDATE is YYYY-MM-DD.
